In the evaluation of psychiatric care metrics, **outlier performance** identifies departments that achieve exceptionally high results compared to standard benchmarks. According to the 2024 ADHD clinical data, three specific departments stood out as high-performing outliers by reaching or exceeding an 80% threshold in their measured proportion [^src1]. 

These top-performing entities were [[psy-lokalpsykiatri-toender|PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Tønder)]], which achieved the highest rate at 83%; [[pho-klinik-1-for-psykiatriske-lidelser-horsens|PHO Klinik 1 for Psykiatriske Lidelser – Horsens]] at 82%; and [[pmi-klinik-for-depression-og-mani-midt|PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt]], which met the threshold at exactly 80% [^src1].

## Claims

- Tre afdelinger nåede en andel på/over 80 %: PSY Lokalpsykiatri (Tønder) (83 %), PHO Klinik 1 for Psykiatriske Lidelser – Horsens (82 %) og PMI Klinik for depression og mani – Midt (80 %).[^src1]
